title: The chapel bell’s counterweights
body: Each handwheel turns a winding drum, and its rope runs over a pulley to the iron eye on a stone counterweight. The stretch just above the eye used to disappear as the weight dropped. I fixed it on both sides, so you can follow each rope while the balance dial tips between the weights.

videos.caption: One complete cycle of the chapel bell mechanism, with both stone counterweights in view.
